nodes.name: Dual-confinement synthesis of HES-PCNF
nodes.procedure: HES-PCNF (high-entropy sulfide embedded in porous carbon nanofibers) was synthesized via a dual-confinement strategy. Specifically, Zn-based MOFs with hierarchical micropores served as sacrificial templates, synergistically leveraging physical confinement and chemical anchoring. Subsequent controlled calcination and sulfurization yielded uniformly dispersed HES on interconnected porous carbon nanofibers scaffolds.
